connectors.name: Microsoft 365 / Microsoft Graph + Entra
connectors.useCase:
• Employee sign-in and directory profile
• Mail, calendar, Teams and file actions in AURA
connectors.summary: Broad daily reach and reusable identity/collaboration layer

enterpriseLaunch.rationale: Identity layer for every other journey. Assumes customers run Entra (to confirm). Build SSO as generic OIDC/SAML with Entra as first adapter.

connectors.name: SAP S/4HANA
connectors.useCase:
• Create or track procurement requests and orders
• Show invoice status, supplier data and selected approvals
connectors.summary: Live pipeline and core execution system; roadmap states first enterprise release

enterpriseLaunch.rationale: ERP for procurement/finance. SuccessFactors does not imply S/4: build only when a customer confirms it.

connectors.name: SAP SuccessFactors
connectors.useCase:
• Show employee and organization information
• Track leave and HR request status where modules support it
connectors.summary: Primary HR source for SAP customers

enterpriseLaunch.rationale: HR system of record for all three enterprises. Needs a customer test/preview tenant. Source of truth for Qiwa/GOSI/Muqeem matching.

connectors.name: ServiceNow
connectors.useCase:
• Submit employee IT incidents or service requests
• Display approval and ticket status in AURA
connectors.summary: Strong employee service desk execution and ticket transparency

enterpriseLaunch.rationale: Strong IT/service-desk fit but unknown whether launch customers run it.

connectors.name: SPL National Address
connectors.useCase:
• Validate employee or office national address
• Use verified address data for onboarding/service delivery
connectors.summary: Saudi-local onboarding quality with broad reach

enterpriseLaunch.rationale: Day-one journey 3; no government approval needed beyond customer registering for the SPL key. Confirm quota/price in writing.

connectors.name: Oracle Fusion ERP / HCM
connectors.useCase:
• Read worker and leave information
• Create or track procurement requisitions
connectors.summary: Large-enterprise alternative to SAP

enterpriseLaunch.rationale: Customers run SuccessFactors; not needed for launch.

connectors.name: Dynamics 365 / Dataverse
connectors.useCase:
• Create or view customer/employee service cases
• Show case progress in AURA
connectors.summary: Reusable Microsoft ecosystem extension

enterpriseLaunch.rationale: Not evidenced in launch customers' stack.

connectors.name: PayTabs
connectors.useCase:
• Collect a fee for an eligible employee service
• Reconcile payment before fulfilling the request
connectors.summary: Monetization only where AURA owns a payable journey

enterpriseLaunch.rationale: Merchant-of-record model undecided; most Hub journeys are free to employees.

connectors.name: IATA
connectors.useCase:
• Validate a travel agency code during vendor onboarding
• Record valid/invalid result and freshness
connectors.summary: Useful for a narrow travel partner workflow

enterpriseLaunch.rationale: Supplier onboarding for travel agencies; Employee Hub fit 29.

connectors.name: Nafath
connectors.useCase:
• Verify national digital identity for an employee journey
• Potentially support trusted sign-in or approval
connectors.summary: High potential trust and reach

enterpriseLaunch.rationale: Needs AURA/customer as relying party. Keep corporate SSO as normal login; consider step-up for sensitive HR changes later.

connectors.name: Qiwa
connectors.useCase:
• Show employment-contract or job-change status
• Guide employee through selected labor service
connectors.summary: Major Saudi employee lifecycle value

enterpriseLaunch.rationale: Highest Saudi employee value; no public API evidenced. Ship guided handoff now (contract review, certificate); API only if Qiwa/HRSD approves.

connectors.name: Etimad APIs
connectors.useCase:
• Show public-sector procurement information
• Track a selected government purchase request
connectors.summary: Strategic for Saudi government customers

enterpriseLaunch.rationale: Government/semi-government products only; none of the launch customers evidenced as in scope.

connectors.name: Absher
connectors.useCase:
• Guide employees to a government transaction
• Show status only if an authorized route exists
connectors.summary: Broad recognition but direct execution rights uncertain

enterpriseLaunch.rationale: No public API; official-channel handoff only. Never collect Absher/Nafath credentials or OTPs.

connectors.name: GOSI
connectors.useCase:
• Show social-insurance status when authorized
• Support employer contribution visibility
connectors.summary: Useful for HR verification in Saudi employers

enterpriseLaunch.rationale: S2S exists for large companies (Elm/stc/Al Rajhi qualify). Start with read/reconciliation vs SuccessFactors; no writes.

connectors.name: Muqeem
connectors.useCase:
• Track expatriate residency or visa services
• Present employee status or official handoff
connectors.summary: Relevant to Saudi employer mobility workflows

enterpriseLaunch.rationale: Professional package advertises API; customer-obtainable but AURA integrator rights and spec unverified. Elm is the Muqeem operator: use as access lever.

connectors.name: Yaqeen
connectors.useCase:
• Verify selected employee/beneficiary identity fields
• Improve onboarding data quality
connectors.summary: Improves data quality and fraud controls for eligible workflows

enterpriseLaunch.rationale: Integrator role must be granted by Elm. Elm is a customer: ask for the integrator pathway.

connectors.name: ZATCA Integration Service
connectors.useCase:
• Issue an invoice for a paid employee service
• Retrieve invoice status or file for finance
connectors.summary: Useful finance workflow only when AURA bills locally

enterpriseLaunch.rationale: Depends on who the taxable seller is; no clear paid employee journey yet.

connectors.name: NIC
connectors.useCase:
• Check Hajj person eligibility when authorized
• Validate/create/cancel worker permit in relevant program
connectors.summary: High for pilgrimage-sector operators; limited general hub reach

enterpriseLaunch.rationale: Hajj-sector specific. Revisit only for a Hajj operator customer.

connectors.name: Ministry of Commerce
connectors.useCase:
• Verify company commercial registration for agent onboarding
• Check owner relationship only if authorized
connectors.summary: Relevant to external organization validation

enterpriseLaunch.rationale: Business-entity checks; low employee value; transactional access unverified.

connectors.name: Mudad
connectors.useCase:
• Show payroll/WPS process status if authorized
• Assist employees with salary-related requests
connectors.summary: Valuable to HR/payroll customers but narrow employee-facing flow

enterpriseLaunch.rationale: Wage-issue journey is high value. Al Rajhi's bank documents an automated WPS route, so employer-side status may come via the bank, not a Mudad API.

connectors.name: SADAD
connectors.useCase:
• Issue a bill reference for a paid service
• Reconcile settlement before completion
connectors.summary: Alternative payment rail where a biller relationship exists

enterpriseLaunch.rationale: Requires biller/sub-biller status; bill creation is not payment confirmation.

connectors.name: Ajeer
connectors.useCase:
• Show temporary-worker assignment/permit status
• Guide an eligible employer service request
connectors.summary: Sector-specific employee services

enterpriseLaunch.rationale: Seasonal/temporary labor; limited fit for these enterprises.

connectors.name: CRS
connectors.useCase:
• Search hotel availability for staff travel
• Reserve, modify or cancel a selected booking
connectors.summary: Potential travel benefits, but provider identity unresolved

enterpriseLaunch.rationale: Supplier unidentified; booking liability unresolved.

connectors.name: SAR through Masar Integration Gateway
connectors.useCase:
• Search and book rail for staff travel
• Pay, inquire or cancel using saved booking ID
connectors.summary: Sector-specific travel fulfilment

enterpriseLaunch.rationale: Intermediary authority unverified.

connectors.name: MOFA
connectors.useCase:
• Register an approved external agent for visa workflow
• Track accepted or rejected registration
connectors.summary: Narrow travel/pilgrimage operations

enterpriseLaunch.rationale: Travel-agent registration; indirect employee value.

connectors.name: MOI
connectors.useCase:
• Create or update an Umrah agent record
• Track accepted/rejected agent status
connectors.summary: Narrow sector execution use case

enterpriseLaunch.rationale: Regulated agent registration; not an employee journey.

connectors.name: Nusuk Imtithal / Sahab
connectors.useCase:
• Send field-inspection and incident updates
• Correlate them to ticket and employee/location
connectors.summary: Pilgrimage operations, outside general employee hub

enterpriseLaunch.rationale: Hajj inspection workflow; owner and inbound API unverified.

connectors.name: Tasheer Connect
connectors.useCase:
• Submit a visa/travel service form
• Update email, change form or hold request
connectors.summary: Travel-specialist request execution

enterpriseLaunch.rationale: All four routes are writes; visa-form specialist.

connectors.name: Atlas
connectors.useCase:
• Sync nationality reference data
• Sync hotel lookup data for travel workflows
connectors.summary: Supporting lookup data for pilgrimage travel, narrow hub relevance

enterpriseLaunch.rationale: Provider identity unknown; name collides with an unrelated Saudi Atlas.

connectors.name: Kidana
connectors.useCase:
• Retrieve a Hajj-site handover report file
• Deliver it to an authorized employee
connectors.summary: Specialized Hajj operations

enterpriseLaunch.rationale: Single document-retrieval route; Holy Sites operations only.

phaseOne.title: Enterprise Phase One
phaseOne.scope: Shared Saudi enterprise journey architecture for Elm, stc and Al Rajhi
phaseOne.guardrail: Read-only APIs and official handoffs; no transactional writes.

foundation.title: Shared enterprise foundation
foundation.gate: Confirm each customer's Entra tenant and SuccessFactors test access.

journeys.name: Sign in, profile and job info
journeys.dependsOn: Customer Entra app registration; SuccessFactors test tenant
journeys.nextGate: Confirm each customer's Entra tenant and provide a SuccessFactors test tenant.
journeys.sourceNote: Official APIs verified; customer stack remains to be confirmed.

journeys.name: Leave status and 'my day'
journeys.connectors: SAP SuccessFactors Time Off; Microsoft Graph calendar
journeys.dependsOn: Time Off module licensed; calendar consent
journeys.nextGate: Confirm Time Off licensing, employee scope and delegated calendar consent.
journeys.sourceNote: OData and Graph are documented; tenant modules and consent are customer-specific.

journeys.name: Address update/verification
journeys.dependsOn: Customer SPL registration; quota and price confirmed
journeys.nextGate: Register the customer, select the address API product and confirm quota, terms and production use.
journeys.sourceNote: Official address APIs and subscription products are published.

journeys.name: Employment contract / certificate
journeys.dependsOn: Official deep links; no public API claimed
journeys.nextGate: Confirm official service links and keep employee approval and certification in Qiwa.
journeys.sourceNote: Official service journeys are documented; machine access remains unverified.

journeys.name: Residency / Iqama expiry
journeys.dependsOn: Elm/customer Professional package; specification and sandbox
journeys.nextGate: Confirm customer entitlement, direct-API scope, specification, sandbox and identifier matching.
journeys.sourceNote: Public product material indicates an API product; exact AURA rights remain unverified.

journeys.name: Insurance status and wage-issue guidance
journeys.connectors: GOSI; Mudad or customer bank route
journeys.dependsOn: GOSI S2S eligibility; bank WPS route; sandbox
journeys.nextGate: Confirm GOSI S2S eligibility and the customer's bank/Mudad route, permitted status data and test access.
journeys.sourceNote: GOSI S2S and Al Rajhi automated WPS routes are public; exact customer rights remain gated.
